subject: Anglais
title: Anglais · Terminale · Grammaire · Emphase et synthèse
description: Règles et automatismes — emphase et synthèse.

cards.front: Mets en relief le moment : They acted in 2020.
cards.back: It was in 2020 that they acted.

cards.front: Mets en relief le besoin : We need a long-term solution.
cards.back: What we need is a long-term solution.

cards.front: Reformule avec rarely : Governments rarely agree so quickly.
cards.back: Rarely do governments agree so quickly.

cards.front: Complète : Not only ___ costly, but it is also ineffective.
cards.back: Not only is it costly, but it is also ineffective.

cards.front: Réduis : Because it was designed carefully, the policy succeeded.
cards.back: Designed carefully, the policy succeeded.

cards.front: Nominalise : The government decided to intervene.
cards.back: The government's decision to intervene…

cards.front: Traduis : « Cette mesure est susceptible d'échouer. »
cards.back: This measure is likely to fail.

cards.front: Atténue : The policy is effective.
cards.back: The policy appears to be effective.

cards.front: Traduis : « Aussi utile soit-elle, la mesure reste coûteuse. »
cards.back: Useful though it may be, the measure remains costly.

cards.front: Relie deux documents convergents mais différents.
cards.back: Both documents highlight…, although they approach it from different perspectives.
